parameters.name: hostname

set protocols ldp router-id loopback0.explanation: Configure the LDP protocol router ID.

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] interface [parameter2]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 interface ge-1/0/1

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] interface [parameter2]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 interface ge-1/0/2
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的接口。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] destination [parameter2]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 destination 5.5.5.5
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的目的地址。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] path-option [parameter2] explicit host-name [parameter3]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 path-option 10 explicit host-name LSRA_PATH
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的路径选项。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] record-route
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 record-route
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程隧道的路由记录功能。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] autoroute announce
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 autoroute announce
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程隧道的自动路由通告功能。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel [parameter1] backup-path [parameter2]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tun1 backup-path LSR_A_BACKUP
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnel tu.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的备份路径。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-prio.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-priority [parameter1] tunnel-id [parameter2]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-prio.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-priority 1 tunnel-id 100
set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-prio.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程路径的优先级和隧道ID。

set protocols isis net 49.0001.0000.0000.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的NET地址并限制为Level-2。
